say:0:1223402001:0.text: That's... Cecil from the Water Wights!
say:0:1223402001:0.male: That's... Cecil from the Water Wights!
say:0:1223402001:0.female: That's... Cecil from the Water Wights!

say:1:1223403001:1.text: Al sent me here. He wanted you to know that our fish stall has opened...
say:1:1223403001:1.source_cn: 阿尔让我给你们捎个口信，最近鱼铺算是开张了……
say:1:1223403001:1.male: Al sent me here. He wanted you to know that our fish stall has opened...
say:1:1223403001:1.female: Al sent me here. He wanted you to know that our fish stall has opened...

say:2:1223403002:1.text: You've helped us a lot these days, and we want to do something for you in return.
say:2:1223403002:1.source_cn: 不管怎样，你帮了我们很多，水鬼知恩图报，我们想回报你。
say:2:1223403002:1.male: You've helped us a lot these days, and we want to do something for you in return.
say:2:1223403002:1.female: You've helped us a lot these days, and we want to do something for you in return.

say:3:1223403003:1.text: Please drop by our stall when you're free!
say:3:1223403003:1.source_cn: 你要是有空，来一趟鱼铺吧？
say:3:1223403003:1.male: Please drop by our stall when you're free!
say:3:1223403003:1.female: Please drop by our stall when you're free!

choice_prompt:4:1223403003.text: Please drop by our stall when you're free!
choice_prompt:4:1223403003.source_cn: 你要是有空，来一趟鱼铺吧？
choice_prompt:4:1223403003.male: Please drop by our stall when you're free!
choice_prompt:4:1223403003.female: Please drop by our stall when you're free!

say:5:1223403006:1.text: The stall is at the usual spot. I'm heading there now.
say:5:1223403006:1.source_cn: 还是老地方，我先过去了。
say:5:1223403006:1.male: The stall is at the usual spot. I'm heading there now.
say:5:1223403006:1.female: The stall is at the usual spot. I'm heading there now.

say:8:1223403005:1.text: It's the least we could do.
say:8:1223403005:1.male: It's the least we could do.
say:8:1223403005:1.female: It's the least we could do.

say:2:1223404001:1.text: You need to ship my order right now!
say:2:1223404001:1.source_cn: 我要你们现在就给我发货！立刻！马上！

say:3:1223404002:1.text: Calm down, boddy. You sound like we're deliberately delaying your shipment.
say:3:1223404002:1.source_cn: 冷静点老哥，你这样好像我们有货故意不给你们发一样。

say:4:1223404003:1.text: I don't care what's happening! I just want my order now!
say:4:1223404003:1.source_cn: 我不管你们有没有货，我现在就要！

say:5:1223404004:1.text: How about I get someone reliable to follow up with your order and arrange shipment immediately?
say:5:1223404004:1.source_cn: 你看要不这样吧，我让靠谱的兄弟过去催催，马上给你安排上发货。

say:6:1223404005:1.text: Are you trying to brush me off, you waterless cod? How many times have you said that?
say:6:1223404005:1.source_cn: 小子，你又搪塞我是吧！？你叫几个弟兄去了？

say:7:1223404006:1.text: I assure you we'll ship your order immediately once it's ready!
say:7:1223404006:1.source_cn: 别急，我们安排好马上给您发，我敢保证！

say:8:1223404007:0.text: I'll smash your stall if I don't receive my order soon!
say:8:1223404007:0.source_cn: 我要是再看不到那批货到，就砸了你的鱼铺！

say:9:1223404008:0.text: Don't worry, your order will reach you shortly. Please go home and wait for it.
say:9:1223404008:0.source_cn: 放心，货跑不了，您回去等货吧。

say:11:1223404009:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm sorry you have to see this.
say:11:1223404009:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm sorry you have to see this.
say:11:1223404009:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm sorry you have to see this.

say:12:1223404010:1.text: We meant to do something to repay your kindness, but now...
say:12:1223404010:1.source_cn: 原本兄弟们想酬谢下你，但现在……
say:12:1223404010:1.male: We meant to do something to repay your kindness, but now...
say:12:1223404010:1.female: We meant to do something to repay your kindness, but now...

choice_prompt:13:1223404010.text: We meant to do something to repay your kindness, but now...
choice_prompt:13:1223404010.source_cn: 原本兄弟们想酬谢下你，但现在……
choice_prompt:13:1223404010.male: We meant to do something to repay your kindness, but now...
choice_prompt:13:1223404010.female: We meant to do something to repay your kindness, but now...

say:15:1223404015:0.text: None of my crew are reliable. Could you lend me a hand... again?
say:15:1223404015:0.source_cn: 能用的人手都靠不住，能不能……劳烦你。
say:15:1223404015:0.male: None of my crew are reliable. Could you lend me a hand... again?
say:15:1223404015:0.female: None of my crew are reliable. Could you lend me a hand... again?

choice_prompt:16:1223404015.text: None of my crew are reliable. Could you lend me a hand... again?
choice_prompt:16:1223404015.source_cn: 能用的人手都靠不住，能不能……劳烦你。
choice_prompt:16:1223404015.male: None of my crew are reliable. Could you lend me a hand... again?
choice_prompt:16:1223404015.female: None of my crew are reliable. Could you lend me a hand... again?

say:18:1223404019:0.text: Could you please find out why our goods haven't arrived yet? We'd truly appreciate it!
say:18:1223404019:0.source_cn: 帮忙看看我们的运货车怎么还没到，拜托了。
say:18:1223404019:0.male: Could you please find out why our goods haven't arrived yet? We'd truly appreciate it!
say:18:1223404019:0.female: Could you please find out why our goods haven't arrived yet? We'd truly appreciate it!

choice:16:0:1.text: Do I get a cut of the money?
choice:16:0:1.male: Do I get a cut of the money?
choice:16:0:1.female: Do I get a cut of the money?

say:20:1223404017:1.text: I'm sure you'll get the problem solved.
say:20:1223404017:1.male: I'm sure you'll get the problem solved.
say:20:1223404017:1.female: I'm sure you'll get the problem solved.

say:21:1223404018:1.text: I promise this is the last time!
say:21:1223404018:1.male: I promise this is the last time!
say:21:1223404018:1.female: I promise this is the last time!

say:23:1223404012:0.text: Are you giving us a hard time on purpose?
say:23:1223404012:0.source_cn: 难不成是故意折腾我们？

choice:13:1:2.text: You want me to run an errand?
choice:13:1:2.male: You want me to run an errand?
choice:13:1:2.female: You want me to run an errand?

say:26:1223404014:0.text: We can't afford it. Even if we could, no one would work for us.
say:26:1223404014:0.source_cn: 没钱，就算有钱也雇不到人。
say:26:1223404014:0.male: We can't afford it. Even if we could, no one would work for us.
say:26:1223404014:0.female: We can't afford it. Even if we could, no one would work for us.

say:0:1223405001:0.text: Magister... There are ruts and scattered fish here.
say:0:1223405001:0.source_cn: 主人……这个车辙，还有散落的鱼。
say:0:1223405001:0.male: Magister... There are ruts and scattered fish here.
say:0:1223405001:0.female: Magister... There are ruts and scattered fish here.

say:1:1223405002:0.text: Looks like the cart's been robbed...
say:1:1223405002:0.male: Looks like the cart's been robbed...
say:1:1223405002:0.female: Looks like the cart's been robbed...

say:0:1223406001:0.text: They're galefish. Thoreau said he was good at catching them.
say:0:1223406001:0.source_cn: 这是狂风鱼，我记得梭罗说擅长抓狂风鱼。
say:0:1223406001:0.male: They're galefish. Thoreau said he was good at catching them.
say:0:1223406001:0.female: They're galefish. Thoreau said he was good at catching them.

say:1:1223406002:0.text: We should let Al know about this.
say:1:1223406002:0.source_cn: 无论如何，将这个情况跟阿尔说下吧。
say:1:1223406002:0.male: We should let Al know about this.
say:1:1223406002:0.female: We should let Al know about this.

say:2:1223407001:1.text: You guys look crestfallen. Was there an accident?
say:2:1223407001:1.source_cn: 看你们的表情，运货车又出意外了？
say:2:1223407001:1.male: You guys look crestfallen. Was there an accident?
say:2:1223407001:1.female: You guys look crestfallen. Was there an accident?

say:3:1223407002:1.text: The goods were stolen, and Thoreau is missing.
say:3:1223407002:1.source_cn: 货被抢了，梭罗也不见了。

say:4:1223407003:1.source_cn: 说实话，你对这个结果也不意外了吧？

say:5:1223407004:1.text: Indeed. I'm used to dealing with all sorts of mishaps every day.
say:5:1223407004:1.source_cn: 是啊，我都习惯每天处理数十个意外了……

say:6:1223407005:1.text: But this time, the galefish was pre-ordered by a customer. To the catch the fish, Thoreau hasn't slept for two days.
say:6:1223407005:1.source_cn: 但这次的狂风鱼，是顾客特意定的货，梭罗为了定期交货两天没睡。

choice_prompt:7:1223407005.text: But this time, the galefish was pre-ordered by a customer. To the catch the fish, Thoreau hasn't slept for two days.
choice_prompt:7:1223407005.source_cn: 但这次的狂风鱼，是顾客特意定的货，梭罗为了定期交货两天没睡。

say:8:1223407006:1.text: Paz, can you and Lia look into it?
say:8:1223407006:1.source_cn: 帕斯，你能带上利娅去看看吗？

say:11:1223407007:0.text: N-no problem! I'm on it now!

say:13:1223407008:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried that Paz can't handle this alone. Could you go with him?
say:13:1223407008:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried that Paz can't handle this alone. Could you go with him?
say:13:1223407008:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried that Paz can't handle this alone. Could you go with him?

choice_prompt:14:1223407008.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried that Paz can't handle this alone. Could you go with him?
choice_prompt:14:1223407008.source_cn: <style=stress><player_name></style>，事关重大，恐怕帕斯自己搞不定，你也过去看看吧。
choice_prompt:14:1223407008.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried that Paz can't handle this alone. Could you go with him?
choice_prompt:14:1223407008.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I'm worried that Paz can't handle this alone. Could you go with him?

say:15:1223407010:0.text: I'm counting on you all. I'll join you after I wrap things up at the stall.
say:15:1223407010:0.source_cn: 拜托了，各位。我收拾完鱼铺的事，也马上会过去。
say:15:1223407010:0.male: I'm counting on you all. I'll join you after I wrap things up at the stall.
say:15:1223407010:0.female: I'm counting on you all. I'll join you after I wrap things up at the stall.

say:17:1223407009:0.text: She's a talented girl, and you'll soon see it. She's going to be a great help.
say:17:1223407009:0.source_cn: 是一个很优秀的女孩，你到了就知道了，她会帮大家的。
say:17:1223407009:0.male: She's a talented girl, and you'll soon see it. She's going to be a great help.
say:17:1223407009:0.female: She's a talented girl, and you'll soon see it. She's going to be a great help.

choice:7:0:1.text: Should we search for the fish?
choice:7:0:1.male: Should we search for the fish?
choice:7:0:1.female: Should we search for the fish?

say:10:1223408005:1.source_cn: 你们说的利娅，不会是这只狗狗吧？

say:11:1223408006:1.text: Yeah! She's brilliant, you know? She can find basically anything!
say:11:1223408006:1.source_cn: 对啊，她很聪明，什么东西都能找回来！

say:12:1223408007:1.text: Al decided to keep a dog when we were robbed last time. Now, it's time for her to show her talent.
say:12:1223408007:1.source_cn: 上次货被劫了后，阿尔让我们养的，现在可以派上用场了。

say:0:1223410001:0.text: Hmm... Why do you stop moving, Lia?
say:0:1223410001:0.source_cn: 呃……利娅小姐，怎么不动了？

say:1:1223410002:0.text: Magister, does she want us to investigate this area?
say:1:1223410002:0.source_cn: 主人，是不是让我们调查下附近啊？
say:1:1223410002:0.male: Magister, does she want us to investigate this area?
say:1:1223410002:0.female: Magister, does she want us to investigate this area?

say:0:1223411001:0.text: I remember this weapon; it belongs to Niko.
say:0:1223411001:0.source_cn: 这把武器，我记得是奈克的家伙。

say:1:1223411002:0.text: It looks like they were dragged away, based on this mark.
say:1:1223411002:0.source_cn: 从这个痕迹来看，他们应该是被拖走的。

say:0:1223412001:0.source_cn: 那是梭罗！我看到梭罗了！

say:1:1223412002:0.text: His blood has attracted some beasts!

say:1:1223413001:0.text: *Coughing*... I knew you guys would come to my aid. Thanks for coming here, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1223413001:0.source_cn: 咳咳……你们来了，我就知道你们会来，给<style=s...
say:1:1223413001:0.male: *Coughing*... I knew you guys would come to my aid. Thanks for coming here, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:1:1223413001:0.female: *Coughing*... I knew you guys would come to my aid. Thanks for coming here, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

say:2:1223413002:0.text: Ha, I count myself pretty lucky.

say:5:1223413004:1.text: Hmph, who else could it be? It's Renata and the rest, of course.
say:5:1223413004:1.source_cn: 哈，还能有谁？雷纳塔的那帮混蛋。

say:6:1223413005:1.text: Renata's been plotting a grand scheme lately, but since Al refused to join, she came to throw a wrench in our business.
say:6:1223413005:1.source_cn: 雷纳塔最近一直想干一票大的，阿尔没同意，就过来捣乱。

say:8:1223413007:1.text: I'm fine, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You keep going. I think they aren't too far off.
say:8:1223413007:1.male: I'm fine, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You keep going. I think they aren't too far off.
say:8:1223413007:1.female: I'm fine, <style="stress"><player_name></style>. You keep going. I think they aren't too far off.

say:9:1223413008:1.text: This is Renata's item. Let Lia take a sniff of it.
say:9:1223413008:1.source_cn: 这是雷纳塔身上的东西，让利娅闻一下。

say:9:1223415004:1.text: There's a hidden tree door here!
say:9:1223415004:1.source_cn: 这里有一个隐蔽的树门！

say:12:1223415005:1.text: Looks like I came at just the right time.

say:13:1223415006:0.text: How did you find your way here?

say:14:1223415007:0.text: Paz left marks along the way that only Water Wights can recognize.
say:14:1223415007:0.source_cn: 帕斯在路上做了标记，只有水鬼能看懂。

say:17:1223415008:0.text: Renata and her men are at it again. We have to teach them a lesson this time!
say:17:1223415008:0.source_cn: 又是雷纳塔干的，准备好打一架吧。

say:18:1223415009:0.text: I can't wait to give them a good beating!

say:21:1223415010:1.text: Shh! As you've surely noticed, many Carmine Whispers are patrolling this area.
say:21:1223415010:1.source_cn: 嘘——你们应该也注意到了，这里有很多血薇帮的人在巡逻。

say:22:1223415011:1.text: This is their territory, and it's dangerous for you to be here.
say:22:1223415011:1.source_cn: 这是血薇帮的地盘，你们出现在这很危险的。

say:23:1223415012:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the hamster lady's right. We aren't supposed to be here.
say:23:1223415012:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the hamster lady's right. We aren't supposed to be here.
say:23:1223415012:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, the hamster lady's right. We aren't supposed to be here.

say:24:1223415013:0.text: But we have to get our buddy out of here anyway. How about we disguise ourselves?
say:24:1223415013:0.source_cn: 但人还是要救的，不然咱们伪装一下？
say:24:1223415013:0.male: But we have to get our buddy out of here anyway. How about we disguise ourselves?
say:24:1223415013:0.female: But we have to get our buddy out of here anyway. How about we disguise ourselves?

choice_prompt:25:1223415013.text: But we have to get our buddy out of here anyway. How about we disguise ourselves?
choice_prompt:25:1223415013.source_cn: 但人还是要救的，不然咱们伪装一下？
choice_prompt:25:1223415013.male: But we have to get our buddy out of here anyway. How about we disguise ourselves?
choice_prompt:25:1223415013.female: But we have to get our buddy out of here anyway. How about we disguise ourselves?

say:26:1223415014:0.text: That's brilliant! But we don't have their uniforms...
say:26:1223415014:0.source_cn: 好主意！但我们没有血薇帮的衣服……
say:26:1223415014:0.male: That's brilliant! But we don't have their uniforms...
say:26:1223415014:0.female: That's brilliant! But we don't have their uniforms...

say:29:1223415015:0.text: This is simple—you can pretend to be captured by Magister, who is going to be dressed like a Carmine Whisper!
say:29:1223415015:0.source_cn: 这简单，假装你们是被主人这个血薇帮成员抓住的水鬼不就行了？

choice:25:0:1.text: Should I dress as a Whisper?
choice:25:0:1.male: Should I dress as a Whisper?
choice:25:0:1.female: Should I dress as a Whisper?

say:0:1223415101:0.text: You look more like the real deal than those Carmine Whispers!
say:0:1223415101:0.source_cn: 你穿这身，看着比血薇帮还正统！
say:0:1223415101:0.male: You look more like the real deal than those Carmine Whispers!
say:0:1223415101:0.female: You look more like the real deal than those Carmine Whispers!

say:0:1223416001:0.text: Magister, there's a stir over there!
say:0:1223416001:0.male: Magister, there's a stir over there!
say:0:1223416001:0.female: Magister, there's a stir over there!

say:1:1223417002:0.text: Tsk, who's that? Aron? Are Renata's guys here?
say:1:1223417002:0.source_cn: 啧，那个是？阿隆？雷纳塔的人？

say:1:1223419001:1.text: Oh, no! Why are they here? W-we have to go!
say:1:1223419001:1.source_cn: 糟了！你们怎么在这？快……快走啊！

narration:5:1223419003:0.text: An earth-shattering explosion takes place nearby...
narration:5:1223419003:0.source_cn: 不远处，传来了巨大的爆炸声……

say:3:1223422002:1.text: Well, at least no one got injured. Let's go.

say:4:1223422003:1.text: Argh... Damn it! Thoreau spent two whole days catching those fish, and they just blew them up like that!
say:4:1223422003:1.source_cn: 可恶……可恶！梭罗花了两天两夜抓的鱼，全炸飞了！

say:5:1223422004:0.text: The Carmine Whispers will get here soon! We have to go, Al!
say:5:1223422004:0.source_cn: 血薇帮的人快到了，是时候跑路了！阿尔！

say:8:1223422005:1.text: It's indeed the Water Wights' doing! Bring them all back!
say:8:1223422005:1.source_cn: 果然是水鬼帮搞的鬼！全部带走！

say:9:1223422006:1.text: No! Renata's behind this! It has nothing to do with us!
say:9:1223422006:1.source_cn: 不！这都是雷纳塔搞的鬼，跟我们没关系！

say:10:1223422007:1.text: Nonsense! Everyone in Rustport knows you Water Wights are running a fish stall. This cart is yours, right?
say:10:1223422007:1.source_cn: 什么雷纳塔，现在全港口的人都知道你们水鬼在开鱼铺，这货...

say:11:1223422008:1.text: Oh, please! Why on earth would I bring my cart all the way here to blow it up? What can I gain from that?
say:11:1223422008:1.source_cn: 你动动脑子！我特意把车推过来炸的吗？我能有什么好处！

say:12:1223422009:1.source_cn: 去和卢卡交代吧，少废话！

choice_prompt:14:1223422009.source_cn: 去和卢卡交代吧，少废话！

say:16:1223422013:1.text: Alright, I suppose these guys couldn't have done anything out of bounds in your presence.
say:16:1223422013:1.source_cn: 好吧，既然有您跟着，这帮人做不了坏事。
say:16:1223422013:1.male: Alright, I suppose these guys couldn't have done anything out of bounds in your presence.
say:16:1223422013:1.female: Alright, I suppose these guys couldn't have done anything out of bounds in your presence.

say:17:1223422014:1.text: Still... I've got to report the explosion to my superiors. Please follow us to our office.
say:17:1223422014:1.source_cn: 但……这边的确出了事，我也得跟上面交差，麻烦一起回血薇...
say:17:1223422014:1.male: Still... I've got to report the explosion to my superiors. Please follow us to our office.
say:17:1223422014:1.female: Still... I've got to report the explosion to my superiors. Please follow us to our office.

narration:18:1223422015:0.text: Knox leads everyone back to the Carmine Whispers' office...
narration:18:1223422015:0.source_cn: 诺克带领众人回到了血薇帮……

say:21:1223422012:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you hanging with these Water Wights?
say:21:1223422012:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, why are you hanging with these Water Wights?

say:5:1223423007:1.text: W-we just wanted to be good citizens as promised!
say:5:1223423007:1.source_cn: 我们、我们只是想遵守和血薇帮的承诺做个好市民！

say:6:1223423008:1.text: So, tell me about the explosion.
say:6:1223423008:1.source_cn: 所以，那个爆炸是怎么回事？

say:8:1223423010:1.text: Renata from the Water Wights? Isn't she one of your own?
say:8:1223423010:1.source_cn: 是水鬼帮的雷纳塔？和你们一伙的？

say:9:1223423011:1.text: She isn't. After the Dead Tide Fleet was defeated, Renata refused to lead an honest life. We've gone our separate ways since then.
say:9:1223423011:1.source_cn: 不，死潮舰队被打败后，雷纳塔不想本分工作，我们就不是一...

say:10:1223423012:1.text: She made us the scapegoat for this explosion!
say:10:1223423012:1.source_cn: 这次爆炸也是她栽赃我们！

say:11:1223423013:1.text: She blew our goods up, warning us of the consequences of not collaborating with them!
say:11:1223423013:1.source_cn: 她炸掉我们的货，是在警告我们，不和他们合作就搞臭我们！

say:12:1223423014:1.text: I see you're trying hard to sever your ties with them.

say:13:1223423015:1.text: I know our infighting sounds outlandish, but it's the truth.
say:13:1223423015:1.source_cn: 我也知道，水鬼帮自己搞自己人很荒谬，但事实就是这样。

say:14:1223423016:1.text: Relax. Today, you've earned yourself a trump card that can keep all of you safe.
say:14:1223423016:1.source_cn: 别紧张，今天你抓到了一张牌，救了你们所有人一命。

say:15:1223423017:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can give these Water Wights a chance, regardless of their involvement with the explosion, but there's a condition.
say:15:1223423017:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can give these Water Wights a chance, regardless of their involvement with the explosion, but there's a condition.
say:15:1223423017:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I can give these Water Wights a chance, regardless of their involvement with the explosion, but there's a condition.

say:16:1223423018:1.text: Be it Renata or Sonata, I don't want any more conniving Water Wights in Rustport.
say:16:1223423018:1.source_cn: 无论是雷纳塔还是蒂纳塔，我不想再看到有图谋不轨的水鬼。

say:17:1223423019:1.text: As long as you can get rid of the corrupted group, I'll consider helping your business.
say:17:1223423019:1.source_cn: 只要你们把不听话的水鬼清理得够彻底，我会考虑帮你们的生...

choice:2:0:1.female: I'm keeping an eye on them.

choice:2:2:3.text: This is for the city's future.

choice_prompt:3:1223424002.female: The Carmine Whispers wouldn't have believed us if it weren't for you.

say:6:1223424006:0.text: By hook or by crook, we have to get rid of Renata.
say:6:1223424006:0.source_cn: 事到如今，只有搞掉雷纳塔了。

say:7:1223424007:1.text: The thing is, how do we go about it?

say:8:1223424008:0.text: We can't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us again! Let me take care of it this time!
say:8:1223424008:0.male: We can't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us again! Let me take care of it this time!
say:8:1223424008:0.female: We can't expect <style="stress"><player_name></style> to help us again! Let me take care of it this time!

say:9:1223424009:1.text: I'll take them down, even if it costs me my life!
say:9:1223424009:1.source_cn: 老子弄不过他们，换命还是没问题的！

say:10:1223424010:1.text: Come on, you can't even get close enough to Renata with so many people around her.
